AIOU Workshop Schedule & Attendance Guide 2026 – Mandatory Requirements Solved Assignment Key

📌 BS / B.Ed / Postgraduate Solved Assignment 📅 Official Spring 2026 Deadline
Assignment 1 (Phase 1) Solved Key July 15, 2026
Assignment 2 (Phase 2) Solved Key August 15, 2026

👨‍🏫 AIOU Workshop Schedule & Attendance Guide 2026

📅 Updated: April 12, 2026 ⏱️ Reading Time: 9 min read 📚 Category: AIOU Resources ⭐ Rating: ★★★★★

Are you an AIOU student confused about workshop schedules, attendance requirements, and what happens if you miss a workshop? You're not alone. Workshops are a critical component of many AIOU programs, yet they remain one of the most misunderstood parts of the distance learning system.

In this comprehensive guide, we'll explain everything you need to know about AIOU workshops — from understanding what they are and why they're mandatory, to checking your schedule, attendance requirements, and what to do if you miss one.

📌 What is an AIOU Workshop? AIOU workshops are mandatory practical training sessions conducted by the university, mainly for BS, PGD, ADC, B.Ed, M.Ed, and teaching programs. In workshops, students attend physical or online sessions, perform practical activities, present lessons or assignments, and earn assessment marks. Attendance is compulsory[reference:0].
🎯 Which Programs Require Workshops?

Not all AIOU programs have workshops. Workshops are typically required for:

  • B.Ed (1.5 / 2.5 / 4-year programs) – Teaching practice workshops are mandatory[reference:1]
  • BS Programs – Including Accounting & Finance, Computer Science, etc.[reference:2]
  • M.Ed / MA Education – Practical training components[reference:3]
  • ADC (Associate Degree in Commerce) – Workshop participation required[reference:4]
  • Postgraduate Programs (M.Phil, PhD) – Research workshops may be required[reference:5]
  • Teaching Practice Courses – Such as 8608, 8609, etc.[reference:6]
⚠️ Note: Matric, FA, BA, and MA programs in non-teaching subjects may not have mandatory workshops. However, always check your course outline or contact your regional office to confirm.
📅 AIOU Workshop Schedule 2026 – Important Dates

AIOU conducts workshops in two main semesters: Spring (March-August) and Autumn (September-February). Here are the key dates for 2026:

SemesterWorkshop PhaseDatesType
Autumn 2026Phase 1June 2-4, 2026 (Mon-Wed)Online/Face-to-Face
Phase 2June 12-14, 2026 (Thu-Sat)Online/Face-to-Face
Spring 2026Main SessionMay 19-24, 2026Online (mostly)
Teaching PracticeFace-to-FaceStarting January 12, 2026Physical (B.Ed courses)
📌 Note: Eid-ul-Adha holidays (June 5-11, 2026) observed — no workshops during this period[reference:7]. Workshop schedules vary by program and region. Always check your personalized schedule via the Aaghi LMS portal[reference:8].
💻 Types of Workshops: Online vs Face-to-Face
🌐 Online Workshops (Aaghi LMS / Microsoft Teams)

Most AIOU workshops are now conducted online through the Aaghi LMS portal. These are mandatory 12-hour interactive sessions (2 hours daily for 6 days) for programs like B.Ed, BS, and specialized courses[reference:9].

Requirements:

  • Microsoft Teams application installed on phone or computer[reference:10]
  • Active internet connection
  • Login through Aaghi LMS portal (not direct MS Teams link)[reference:11]
  • Regular participation during sessions
🏢 Face-to-Face (Physical) Workshops

AIOU face-to-face workshops are mandatory in-person training sessions for specific programs such as postgraduate, M.Phil, B.Ed, and teacher training courses (e.g., 1.5-year B.Ed). These workshops are required to fulfill teaching practice, project, or program requirements[reference:12].

Features:

  • Conducted at AIOU regional offices or designated study centers
  • Usually 5 hours daily for 5-7 days[reference:13]
  • Direct interaction with tutors and resource persons
  • Presentation and practical activities required
📋 Attendance Requirements & Policy

Attendance in workshops is strictly mandatory for eligible programs. Without attending workshops, the course remains incomplete[reference:14]. Here's what you need to know:

Program TypeMinimum Attendance RequiredConsequence of Absence
B.Ed WorkshopsMinimum 80% (at least 4 out of 6 days)[reference:15][reference:16]Mark deduction or fail requirement
BS Programs70-80% recommended[reference:17]May affect final grades
Teaching Practice Courses80% compulsoryCannot proceed with practicum
Online WorkshopsAttendance auto-tracked by systemNo attendance = no marks
⚠️ Important: According to AIOU's modern policy, if you are absent from a workshop, you will not be completely failed, but a significant percentage of marks will be deducted and you will have to complete them in the papers[reference:18]. Missing a workshop may result in being considered to have "forgotten the course"[reference:19].
🔍 How to Check Your Workshop Schedule

Follow these steps to find your personalized workshop schedule:

  • Via Aaghi LMS Portal: Visit aaghi.aiou.edu.pk → Login with your Student ID and Password → Navigate to "Courses" → Workshop schedule displayed in right sidebar[reference:20]
  • Via AIOU Official Website: Go to www.aiou.edu.pk/Workshop.asp → Enter your Student ID, Region, and Program[reference:21]
  • Via SMS: Send WORKSHOP [Roll Number] to 8008 (charges apply)
  • Via Postal Letter: AIOU regional offices dispatch written letters containing workshop timetables[reference:22]
  • Via Regional Office: Visit your nearest AIOU regional office with your roll number
📱 How to Attend Online Workshops (Step-by-Step)
✅ Step-by-Step Guide:
  1. Install Microsoft Teams – Download from official app store (phone) or Microsoft website (PC)[reference:23]
  2. Login to Aaghi LMS Portal – Visit aaghi.aiou.edu.pk with your credentials
  3. Access Workshop Link – Navigate to "Workshop" or "Courses" section and click the provided Teams link
  4. Important: Always join through LMS portal. Joining MS Teams directly will NOT mark your attendance[reference:24]
  5. Participate Actively – The system auto-tracks attendance. Your chat and class are recorded. AIOU Monitoring Office checks everything[reference:25]
  6. Stay Engaged – After every half hour, respond with "yes sir" or similar to show understanding[reference:26]
  7. Complete Quizzes – Some workshops have quizzes. You usually have 72 hours to attempt them[reference:27]
❌ What Happens If You Miss a Workshop?
  • ❌ Marks Deduction: A significant percentage of marks will be deducted[reference:28]
  • ❌ Incomplete Course: Without attending workshops, the course remains incomplete[reference:29]
  • ❌ Fail Consideration: Missing a workshop may result in being considered to have failed that component[reference:30]
  • ❌ Reappear Requirement: You may need to reappear for the workshop in the next semester[reference:31]
  • ❌ Final Grade Impact: Your overall grade may be reduced significantly[reference:32]

✅ Can You Make Up a Missed Workshop?

Yes, in most cases. Students have three chances to attend and pass the workshop assessment. The first chance is in the current semester, the second in the next semester, and the third in the following semester[reference:33]. If you miss a workshop, contact your regional office immediately to arrange for a makeup session.

💡 Tips for Workshop Success
  • ✅ Check schedule early: Don't wait until the last day. Verify your workshop dates at least 2 weeks in advance.
  • ✅ Set reminders: Use phone alarms for daily workshop timings.
  • ✅ Prepare materials: If it's a teaching practice workshop, prepare your lesson plans in advance.
  • ✅ Stable internet: Ensure reliable connection for online workshops.
  • ✅ Join on time: Late entry may not be counted as present.
  • ✅ Take notes: Workshop content may be tested in quizzes or final exams.
  • ✅ Interact with tutors: Ask questions and participate actively.
  • ✅ Save tutor contact: Get your tutor's phone number and email during the workshop for future reference[reference:34].
  • ✅ Keep proof: Screenshot attendance confirmations if possible.
🏢 AIOU Regional Offices for Workshop Queries

If you have any workshop-related issues, visit your nearest AIOU regional office:

  • Islamabad (Main Campus): Sector H-8, Islamabad
  • Lahore: 22-Empress Road, Lahore
  • Karachi: ST-1, Block 15, Gulshan-e-Iqbal, Karachi
  • Peshawar: 13-B, Khyber Road, University Town, Peshawar
  • Quetta: Sariab Road, Near Passport Office, Quetta
  • Multan: 3-KM Bosan Road, Multan
  • Faisalabad: Samundri Road, Faisalabad
  • Rawalpindi: Liaquat Bagh, Murree Road, Rawalpindi
  • Gujranwala: G.T. Road, Near Civil Hospital, Gujranwala
  • Bahawalpur: Yazman Road, Bahawalpur

📞 AIOU Helpline: 051-111-112-468 (Extension 4 for Examinations / 6 for Regional Services)

❓ Frequently Asked Questions
📌 Q1: Are AIOU workshops compulsory for all students?

No, only for specific programs like B.Ed, BS, M.Ed, and teaching practice courses. Matric, FA, BA, and MA programs in non-teaching subjects typically do not require workshops. Always check your course outline[reference:35].

📌 Q2: Can I attend the workshop from my phone?

Yes, online workshops can be attended via the Microsoft Teams app on your smartphone. However, ensure you join through the Aaghi LMS portal link, not directly through Teams[reference:36].

📌 Q3: What if I don't receive my workshop schedule?

Check the Aaghi LMS portal first. If still not available, contact your regional office or call AIOU helpline at 051-111-112-468. Also check your postal mail as AIOU sends physical letters[reference:37].

📌 Q4: Do workshops have exams or quizzes?

Yes, many workshops include quizzes. For example, the Autumn 2026 workshop quiz opens on June 13, 2026, and is available for 72 hours on the LMS portal[reference:38].

📌 Q5: Will I get TA/DA for attending physical workshops?

No, AIOU does not provide any TA/DA (travel allowance/daily allowance) to students attending workshops[reference:39]. However, hostel facilities are available at the main campus for minimal charges[reference:40].

📌 Q6: How is attendance tracked in online workshops?

AIOU uses an auto-generated system for attendance. Your chat and class are on recording mode, and the AIOU Monitoring Office checks everything. You must stay engaged throughout the session[reference:41].

📌 Q7: What is the duration of a typical workshop?

Online workshops: 2 hours daily for 6 days (total 12 hours)[reference:42]. Physical workshops: 5 hours daily for 5-7 days[reference:43].

📌 Q8: Can I miss one day of workshop?

At least 80% attendance is required (e.g., 4 out of 6 days). Missing one day may be acceptable if you maintain 80% overall. However, try to attend all days to avoid any issues[reference:44].

How to Calculate AIOU CGPA 2026 – Complete Guide with Formula & Examples Solved Assignment Key

In this comprehensive guide, we'll explain everything you need to know about AIOU's grading system, the formula to calculate CGPA, practical examples, and tips to improve your CGPA.

📌 What is CGPA? CGPA (Cumulative Grade Point Average) is the average of all your semester GPAs. It represents your overall academic performance throughout your program. CGPA ranges from 0.00 to 4.00.

📋 AIOU Grading System & Grade Points

AIOU follows the standard HEC-approved grading system. Each percentage score is converted into a letter grade and grade point.

Percentage Range Letter Grade Grade Point (GP) Remarks
80% - 100%A+4.00Excellent
75% - 79%A3.70Very Good
70% - 74%B+3.30Good
65% - 69%B3.00Satisfactory
60% - 64%B-2.70Above Average
55% - 59%C+2.30Average
50% - 54%C2.00Below Average
45% - 49%D1.50Pass
40% - 44%E1.00Pass (Minimum)
Below 40%F0.00Fail
⚠️ Important: You need a minimum of 40% marks in BOTH assignments and final exams to pass a course. If you fail a course, it shows as "F" with 0.00 grade points.

📐 The CGPA Formula

CGPA = (Sum of (Credit Hours × Grade Point)) ÷ (Total Credit Hours)

📊 Step-by-Step Guide to Calculate CGPA

Step 1: Know Your Course Credit Hours

Each course at AIOU has assigned credit hours. Common credit hours:

  • BA/BSc courses: Usually 3 credit hours per course
  • MA/MSc courses: Usually 3-4 credit hours per course
  • B.Ed/M.Ed courses: Usually 3 credit hours per course
  • Compulsory courses (Islamiat, Pakistan Studies): 2 credit hours

Step 2: Convert Your Percentage to Grade Point

Use the grading table above to convert your percentage score in each course to a grade point.

Step 3: Calculate Quality Points for Each Course

Quality Points = Credit Hours × Grade Point

Step 4: Sum All Quality Points

Add the quality points of all courses you have completed.

Step 5: Divide by Total Credit Hours

CGPA = Total Quality Points ÷ Total Credit Hours

📝 Practical Example 1: BA Program (First Semester)

Let's calculate CGPA for a BA student who completed 4 courses in the first semester.

Course Credit Hours Percentage Grade Grade Point Quality Points
English 1378%A3.7011.10
Urdu 1385%A+4.0012.00
Islamiat272%B+3.306.60
Pakistan Studies268%B3.006.00
Total1035.70
CGPA = 35.70 ÷ 10 = 3.57

🎯 CGPA to Percentage Conversion

Percentage = CGPA × 25

💡 Tips to Improve Your CGPA

  • ✅ Focus on high-credit courses: They affect your CGPA more than low-credit courses.
  • ✅ Score well in assignments: Assignments contribute 30-40% of your grade. Use our assignment guide!
  • ✅ Retake failed courses: If you fail a course, retake it as soon as possible.
  • ✅ Improve weak subjects: Identify courses where you scored low and work harder next time.
  • ✅ Maintain consistency: A steady performance across semesters is better than ups and downs.

📱 How to Check Your CGPA Online

  • Via Aaghi Portal: Login → My Results → View CGPA
  • Via Official Transcript: Your DMC shows your CGPA
  • Via Regional Office: Request a printed transcript

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

📌 Q1: What is a good CGPA in AIOU?
3.00 and above (First Division) is considered good. 3.50+ is excellent.
📌 Q2: Can I improve my CGPA after graduation?
No. Your CGPA is final after you complete your program.
📌 Q3: How are assignment marks included in CGPA?
Assignment marks are part of your overall percentage for each course.
📌 Q4: What CGPA is required for a master's degree admission?
For MS/M.Phil: Minimum 2.50 CGPA. For PhD: Minimum 3.00 CGPA.

📊 AIOU Assignment Marking Scheme Explained 2026

📅 Updated: April 12, 2026 ⏱️ Reading Time: 10 min read 📚 Category: AIOU Resources ⭐ Rating: ★★★★★

Do you know that assignments contribute 30-40% of your total marks in AIOU? That's right! Your final grade depends significantly on how well you perform in assignments. Yet, many students don't understand how tutors evaluate assignments and what they look for while marking.

In this comprehensive guide, we'll decode the AIOU assignment marking scheme — explaining exactly how marks are distributed, what tutors look for, and most importantly, how you can score maximum marks in every assignment.

📌 Did You Know? A student who scores 85% in assignments but only 50% in exams can still pass with a good overall grade. Assignments are your opportunity to secure marks before the final exam!
📊 Weightage of Assignments in AIOU

AIOU follows a specific weightage system where assignments and final exams contribute to your overall grade.

ComponentWeightage (Percentage)Marks (Out of 100)
Assignments30% - 40%30 - 40 marks
Final Theory Exam60% - 70%60 - 70 marks
Practical Exam (if applicable)Varies by programIncluded in theory or separate
🎯 Important: To pass a course, you need at least 40% marks in assignments AND 40% in final exams separately. Failing in assignments means failing the course, even if you score high in exams!
📝 How Many Assignments per Course?

The number of assignments varies by program level:

  • Matric / FA / BA / BSc: Usually 2 assignments per course
  • MA / MSc / M.Ed: Usually 2-4 assignments per course
  • B.Ed / M.Ed: Often 3-4 assignments including workshop reports
  • Certificate/Diploma Programs: Usually 1-2 assignments
📋 AIOU Assignment Marking Distribution (100 Marks per Assignment)
CriteriaMarks AllocatedPercentage
Content Accuracy & Relevance35-40 marks35-40%
Depth of Knowledge & Analysis20-25 marks20-25%
Structure & Organization10-15 marks10-15%
Originality & Own Words10 marks10%
References & Citations5-10 marks5-10%
Presentation & Neatness5-10 marks5-10%
🔍 Detailed Evaluation Criteria (What Tutors Look For)
📖 1. Content Accuracy & Relevance (35-40 marks)

This is the most important criterion. Your answers must be factually correct and directly address the question asked.

✅ What gives you high marks:

  • Answers that directly answer the question (no irrelevant information)
  • Correct use of definitions, theories, and concepts
  • Information taken from AIOU textbooks and recommended reference books
  • Up-to-date facts and figures (where applicable)

❌ What loses marks:

  • Off-topic or irrelevant answers
  • Outdated or incorrect information
  • Contradictory statements
💡 2. Depth of Knowledge & Analysis (20-25 marks)

Tutors don't want just definitions — they want to see that you understand the topic and can apply the knowledge.

✅ What gives you high marks:

  • Explaining concepts in your own words (not just copying from book)
  • Providing real-life examples to support your points
  • Comparing and contrasting different perspectives
  • Critical analysis rather than just description
  • Connecting theory to practical situations
📑 3. Structure & Organization (10-15 marks)

A well-organized answer is easier to read and understand. Tutors appreciate clear structure.

✅ Ideal Answer Structure:

  • Introduction: Define key terms, state what you'll cover
  • Main Body: 3-5 key points with explanations and examples (use headings)
  • Conclusion: Summarize main points, give final insight
  • References: List sources used
✍️ 4. Originality & Own Words (10 marks)

AIOU tutors check for plagiarism. Copying directly from textbooks or the internet leads to mark deduction.

⚠️ Warning: AIOU has started using plagiarism detection software. If your assignment is found to be copied, you may receive zero marks or be required to resubmit.

✅ How to show originality:

  • Read the topic, understand it, then write in YOUR OWN words
  • Paraphrase instead of quoting directly
  • Add your own examples and interpretations
  • If you must quote, use quotation marks and cite the source
📚 5. References & Citations (5-10 marks)

Using reference books and citing them properly shows you've done wider reading.

✅ What tutors want:

  • At least 2-3 references per assignment (for longer answers)
  • Proper citation format (APA for social sciences, MLA for humanities)
  • Bibliography at the end listing all sources
  • References from AIOU textbooks, reference books, or credible websites

📖 APA Citation Example:
Kothari, C. R. (2020). Research Methodology. New Delhi: New Age International.

🎨 6. Presentation & Neatness (5-10 marks)

First impressions matter! A neat, well-presented assignment creates a positive impression on the tutor.

✅ What gives you full marks:

  • Clean, legible handwriting (if handwritten) or clean typing (if typed)
  • Proper headings and subheadings
  • Consistent formatting (font, spacing, margins)
  • Page numbers on every page
  • No spelling or grammar errors
  • Binding or stapling properly
🎯 Subject-Wise Marking Differences
Subject TypeSpecial FocusWeightage
Science SubjectsFormulas, derivations, numerical problems, diagrams, lab workDiagrams & problems: 30-40%
Social SciencesTheories, case studies, examples, critical analysisAnalysis & examples: 35-40%
MathematicsStep-by-step solutions, formulas, accuracyEach step carries marks
English/LiteratureGrammar, vocabulary, literary analysis, quotesLanguage quality: 20-25%
IslamiatQuranic verses, Hadith references, authentic sourcesReferences: 15-20%
📊 Grade Conversion Table (Assignment Marks)
Marks Obtained (Out of 100)GradeStatusRemarks
80 - 100A+ / AExcellentOutstanding work
70 - 79BVery GoodAbove average
60 - 69CGoodSatisfactory
50 - 59DFairNeeds improvement
40 - 49EPassMinimum passing
Below 40FFailMust reappear
💯 How to Calculate Your Assignment Score

Example Calculation:

Suppose your course has 2 assignments of 100 marks each, and assignments contribute 40% to the final grade.

  • Assignment 1 score: 85/100
  • Assignment 2 score: 75/100
  • Average assignment score: (85 + 75) ÷ 2 = 80/100
  • Assignment contribution to final grade: 80 × 40% = 32 marks out of 40

These 32 marks are carried forward. You need at least 24 marks (40% of 60) in the final exam to pass the course.

🚫 Common Mistakes That Lose Marks
  • ❌ Not reading the question properly – Answering something different from what's asked
  • ❌ Copying directly from the textbook – No originality, high plagiarism risk
  • ❌ Poor handwriting – Tutor can't read = marks deducted
  • ❌ Missing page numbers or headings – Looks unprofessional
  • ❌ No references/bibliography – Looks like no research done
  • ❌ Submitting late – Late fees or marks deduction
  • ❌ Very short answers – Not enough depth
  • ❌ Spelling and grammar mistakes – Shows carelessness
  • ❌ No table of contents – Hard for tutor to navigate
  • ❌ Not answering all parts of a question – Partial marks only
✅ Tips to Score 80%+ in AIOU Assignments
  • ✅ Start early: Don't wait until the last week. Good assignments take time.
  • ✅ Read the question 3 times: Underline keywords like "explain", "compare", "analyze".
  • ✅ Make an outline: Plan your answer before writing.
  • ✅ Use the AIOU textbook as your primary source: It's what tutors expect.
  • ✅ Add 2-3 reference books: Shows wider reading (use the Top 10 Reference Books list).
  • ✅ Write in your own words: Paraphrase, don't copy.
  • ✅ Use headings and subheadings: Makes it easy to read.
  • ✅ Add diagrams/tables where relevant: Visual elements get attention.
  • ✅ Proofread before submission: Check spelling, grammar, and completeness.
  • ✅ Submit on time: Late submission = marks deduction.
  • ✅ Keep a copy: Always photocopy or scan before submitting.
📞 What to Do If You Disagree with Your Assignment Marks

If you believe your assignment was marked unfairly, you have options:

  • Step 1: Contact your tutor politely and ask for feedback on your marks.
  • Step 2: If not satisfied, submit a rechecking request to your regional office within 15 days of result announcement.
  • Step 3: Pay the rechecking fee (approx. Rs. 500-1,000 per assignment).
  • Step 4: A different tutor will re-evaluate your assignment.
  • Step 5: If marks increase, the new marks will apply. If not, original marks stand.
❓ Frequently Asked Questions
📌 Q1: What is the minimum passing marks in AIOU assignments?

40% (40 out of 100). Below 40 is a fail. You need to pass assignments AND final exams separately to pass the course.

📌 Q2: Do assignments affect my CGPA?

Yes! Assignment marks are included in your final grade calculation, which determines your CGPA. Good assignment scores boost your overall CGPA.

📌 Q3: Can I submit typed assignments instead of handwritten?

Yes, most AIOU programs accept typed assignments. Use Times New Roman or Arial, font size 12, with 1.5 line spacing. Typed assignments often get better presentation marks.

📌 Q4: How long does it take to get assignment results?

Typically 4-8 weeks after submission. Results are sent to your regional office and may be updated on the Aaghi Portal.

📌 Q5: Can I resubmit an assignment if I get low marks?

Generally, no. Assignments are one-time submissions. However, if you failed an assignment, you may be allowed to submit a revised assignment (check with your tutor).

📌 Q6: Do I get marks for attendance in workshops?

For some programs (B.Ed, M.Ed, MBA), workshop attendance is mandatory and may carry 5-10 marks in your assignment or practical component.

📌 Q7: How do I check my assignment marks?

Check via Aaghi Portal (LMS), ask your tutor, or visit your regional office. Some tutors return marked assignments via mail or in person.

📌 Q8: What if my assignment is lost in the mail?

If you have proof of submission (courier receipt, acknowledgment), contact your regional office. You may be allowed to submit a duplicate. Always keep a copy!

🎓 AIOU Scholarship Application Process 2026 – Complete Guide

📅 Updated: April 12, 2026 ⏱️ Reading Time: 9 min read 📚 Category: AIOU Resources ⭐ Rating: ★★★★★

Education is a powerful tool, but financial constraints should never be a barrier. Allama Iqbal Open University (AIOU) offers various scholarship programs for deserving, needy, and meritorious students. Whether you're pursuing Matric, FA, BA, BSc, MA, MSc, B.Ed, or M.Ed, there are scholarships available to support your educational journey.

In this comprehensive guide, we'll explain everything you need to know about AIOU scholarships — from types and eligibility to application process, required documents, deadlines, and tips to increase your chances of selection.

📌 Did You Know? AIOU allocates millions of rupees annually for student scholarships. Thousands of students benefit each year. Don't miss out — apply if you meet the criteria!
🏆 Types of Scholarships Available at AIOU
🎓 Need-Based Scholarship (Financial Assistance) Most Common

For students from low-income families who cannot afford tuition fees. Priority is given to orphans, children of widows, and students with disabilities.

Award Amount: 50% to 100% tuition fee waiver

Eligibility: Family income below PKR 25,000/month

⭐ Merit-Based Scholarship High Achievers

For students with excellent academic performance in previous exams. Encourages high achievers to continue their education.

Award Amount: 25% to 75% tuition fee waiver

Eligibility: Minimum 70% marks in last exam / 3.0 CGPA

👩‍🎓 Women Scholarship Program Empowering Women

Special scholarships for female students to promote female education, especially in rural and remote areas.

Award Amount: 50% tuition fee waiver

Eligibility: Female students enrolled in any AIOU program

🌄 Remote Area Scholarship Rural Support

For students belonging to remote, underdeveloped, or disaster-affected areas (Balochistan, Gilgit-Baltistan, Tharparkar, etc.).

Award Amount: 50% to 100% tuition fee waiver

Eligibility: Domicile of eligible remote area

♿ Special Person / Disability Scholarship Inclusive Education

For students with physical or mental disabilities. Special quota reserved for differently-abled students.

Award Amount: 100% tuition fee waiver + book allowance

Eligibility: Valid disability certificate from recognized medical board

🏅 HEC Need-Based Scholarship (Through AIOU) Government Funded

Funded by the Higher Education Commission (HEC) for deserving students across Pakistan. AIOU acts as the implementing partner.

Award Amount: Up to PKR 120,000 per year

Eligibility: Family income below PKR 45,000/month + academic merit

📚 Hafiz-e-Quran Scholarship Religious Recognition

For students who have completed Hifz (memorization of the Holy Quran). Recognizes religious dedication.

Award Amount: 25% tuition fee waiver

Eligibility: Verified Hafiz-e-Quran certificate

📋 General Eligibility Criteria for AIOU Scholarships
  • ✅ Must be a registered student of AIOU (valid roll number)
  • ✅ Must have minimum 40% marks in last semester/annual exams (for continuing scholarships)
  • ✅ Must not be availing any other scholarship simultaneously
  • ✅ Family income must be below prescribed limit (for need-based)
  • ✅ Must submit complete application before deadline
  • ✅ Must maintain good attendance in workshops (if applicable)
📝 Step-by-Step AIOU Scholarship Application Process
Step 1: Check Scholarship Announcement

Scholarships are announced at the beginning of each semester (Spring: January-February, Autumn: July-August). Check:

  • 📢 AIOU Official Website: www.aiou.edu.pk (News & Announcements section)
  • 📢 Your Regional Office: Notice boards at regional campuses
  • 📢 Aaghi Portal: Student dashboard notifications
  • 📢 Newspapers: Dawn, Jang, The News (national dailies)
Step 2: Download Application Form
  • Visit the AIOU website → "Student Services" → "Scholarships"
  • Download the Scholarship Application Form (PDF format)
  • Alternatively, collect a physical form from your regional office
Step 3: Gather Required Documents

📄 Essential Documents Checklist:

  • ✅ Duly filled Scholarship Application Form (signed)
  • ✅ Attested copy of CNIC (student and father/guardian)
  • ✅ Attested copy of B-Form (for under 18 students)
  • ✅ Attested copy of last exam result/DMC (previous semester/annual)
  • ✅ AIOU Roll Number Slip (current semester)
  • ✅ Income Certificate from Union Council or employer (for need-based)
  • ✅ Electricity/Gas/Sui Gas Bill (proof of residence)
  • ✅ Father/Guardian's CNIC copy (attested)
  • ✅ Passport-size photographs (2-4 copies)
  • ✅ Domicile Certificate (for remote area scholarship)
  • ✅ Disability Certificate (for special person scholarship)
  • ✅ Hafiz-e-Quran Certificate (for Hafiz scholarship)
  • ✅ Death Certificate of father/mother (if applicable, for orphan scholarship)
Step 4: Submit Application
  • Online Submission (if available): Upload scanned documents to the scholarship portal
  • Physical Submission: Submit the complete application package at your nearest AIOU Regional Office or Main Campus (Islamabad)
  • By Post/Courier: Send to "Directorate of Student Financial Aid, Allama Iqbal Open University, Sector H-8, Islamabad"
  • Get Acknowledgment: Always obtain a receipt or acknowledgment slip with submission date
Step 5: Selection Process

Applications are reviewed by the AIOU Scholarship Committee. Selection is based on:

  • Financial need (income level)
  • Academic performance (previous marks)
  • Category/Quota (women, disabled, remote area, etc.)
  • Completeness and accuracy of application
Step 6: Interview (If Required)

Some scholarships require a personal interview or home visit for verification. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted via SMS or phone call.

Step 7: Result Announcement & Award

Selected candidates are notified via:

  • SMS to registered mobile number
  • Notice at regional office
  • Online portal (if applicable)

The scholarship amount is adjusted against tuition fees or disbursed via bank account.

📅 Important Deadlines (Typical Schedule)
SemesterScholarship AnnouncementApplication DeadlineResult Announcement
Spring Semester
(March - August)		 January - February March 15 April - May
Autumn Semester
(September - February)		 July - August September 15 October - November
⚠️ Important: Deadlines are strictly enforced. Late applications are not accepted. Apply at least 2 weeks before the deadline.
💡 Tips to Increase Your Chances of Getting a Scholarship
  • ✅ Apply early: Don't wait until the last day. Early applications get more attention.
  • ✅ Complete all fields: Incomplete applications are rejected immediately.
  • ✅ Attest documents properly: Get copies attested by a gazetted officer or your regional office.
  • ✅ Write a compelling statement: If required, explain your financial situation clearly and honestly.
  • ✅ Maintain good grades: Scholarships often require renewal each semester based on performance.
  • ✅ Apply for multiple scholarships: Don't limit yourself to one. Apply for all you're eligible for.
  • ✅ Keep copies of everything: Maintain a file of all submitted documents and receipts.
  • ✅ Follow up: Politely check the status of your application after 3-4 weeks.
❌ Common Reasons for Scholarship Rejection
  • ❌ Incomplete application (missing documents or signatures)
  • ❌ Late submission after deadline
  • ❌ Incorrect or falsified information
  • ❌ Income exceeds eligible limit
  • ❌ Low academic performance (below 40% marks)
  • ❌ Already availing another scholarship
  • ❌ Unattested document copies
  • ❌ Not meeting specific category requirements
🏛️ Other External Scholarships for AIOU Students
🇵🇰 Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF)

For Punjab domicile holders. Offers scholarships for intermediate to PhD level.

Apply: www.peef.org.pk

🇵🇰 Benazir Bhutto Shaheed Youth Program (BBSYP)

For students from low-income families across Pakistan.

Apply: www.bisp.gov.pk

🌍 HEC Overseas Scholarships

For MS/PhD level students. Covers tuition and living expenses for foreign universities.

Apply: www.hec.gov.pk

🏦 Bank Alfalah Scholarship Program

Corporate scholarship for deserving students across Pakistan.

📍 AIOU Directorate of Student Financial Aid

Address: Directorate of Student Financial Aid, Allama Iqbal Open University, Sector H-8, Islamabad.

Phone: 051-111-112-468 (Extension 6 for Financial Aid)

Email: financialaid@aiou.edu.pk

❓ Frequently Asked Questions
📌 Q1: Can I apply for a scholarship if I'm a new student?

Yes! Newly admitted students can apply based on their last academic qualification (Matric, FA, BA, etc.) results. You must have a valid AIOU roll number.

📌 Q2: How much scholarship amount can I get?

It varies by scholarship type. Need-based scholarships offer 50-100% tuition waiver. HEC scholarships offer up to PKR 120,000 per year. Merit scholarships offer 25-75% waiver.

📌 Q3: Is there a separate application for each scholarship?

Yes. Each scholarship has its own application form and requirements. Read the announcement carefully. Some scholarships use a common application form.

📌 Q4: Can I apply for a scholarship if I already have a degree?

Scholarships are for currently enrolled students. If you have completed your degree, you cannot apply. Apply at the beginning of your program.

📌 Q5: How will I know if I'm selected?

Selected candidates receive an SMS on their registered mobile number. Names are also displayed on regional office notice boards and the AIOU website.

📌 Q6: Can I reapply if rejected?

Yes, you can apply again in the next semester. Work on improving your application and gather all required documents properly.

📌 Q7: Do I need to repay the scholarship?

No, scholarships are gifts — they don't need to be repaid. However, some scholarships may require a service commitment (e.g., teaching in a remote area for 2 years).

📌 Q8: Can international students apply for AIOU scholarships?

AIOU scholarships are primarily for Pakistani nationals. International students should check with their home country's scholarship programs.

📜 How to Apply for AIOU Degree Transcript 2026 – Complete Guide

📅 Updated: April 12, 2026 ⏱️ Reading Time: 8 min read 📚 Category: AIOU Resources ⭐ Rating: ★★★★★

After successfully completing your program from Allama Iqbal Open University (AIOU), the next crucial step is obtaining your official transcript (Detailed Marks Certificate / DMC). Whether you're applying for a job, seeking admission to a foreign university, or applying for a visa, your academic transcript is an essential document.

In this comprehensive guide, we'll explain everything you need to know about applying for an AIOU transcript — from application methods and required documents to fee structure, processing time, and tracking your application.

📌 What is a Transcript (DMC)? A transcript or Detailed Marks Certificate (DMC) is an official document that lists all courses you studied, your semester-wise marks, overall CGPA, and total percentage. It's different from your degree certificate (which only confirms completion).
📋 When Do You Need an AIOU Transcript?
  • 🎓 Higher Education Abroad: For admission to foreign universities (MS, PhD, etc.)
  • 💼 Job Applications: Government and private sector jobs require official transcripts
  • 🛂 Visa Applications: Study or work visa applications need academic records
  • 🏛️ HEC Attestation: Required for degree attestation from HEC
  • 📊 Professional Certifications: Many professional bodies require transcripts
  • 🔄 Credit Transfer: If transferring to another university
🔍 2 Methods to Apply for AIOU Transcript
💻 Method 1: Apply Online for AIOU Transcript (Recommended)

The easiest and fastest way to apply for your transcript is through AIOU's online transcript portal. You can apply from anywhere in the world.

📝 Step-by-Step Process:
  • Visit the official AIOU Transcript Portal: https://www.aiou.edu.pk/Transcript
  • Click on "Apply for Transcript / DMC"
  • Fill out the online application form with:
    • Full Name (as per matriculation certificate)
    • Father's Name
    • Roll Number
    • Program Name (BA, BSc, MA, MSc, B.Ed, etc.)
    • Year of Passing / Semester
    • CNIC Number
    • Mobile Number
    • Postal Address (for delivery)
    • Number of copies required
  • Upload scanned copies of required documents (see list below)
  • Pay the transcript fee online (via credit card, bank transfer, or Easypaisa/JazzCash)
  • Submit the application and save the application tracking number
  • Your transcript will be delivered to your postal address within 15-30 working days
🔗 Direct Transcript Portal: https://www.aiou.edu.pk/Transcript
✅ Pro Tip: After submitting, save the tracking number and screenshot of the application. You'll need it to check status or follow up.
📮 Method 2: Apply Offline at AIOU Regional Office

If you prefer physical submission or have trouble with online payment, you can apply at any AIOU regional office.

  • Visit your nearest AIOU Regional Office (addresses listed below)
  • Get the "Transcript Application Form" from the Examination/Student Services counter
  • Fill out the form completely (use block letters)
  • Attach attested copies of required documents
  • Pay the fee via bank challan or at the office cash counter
  • Submit the form and get a receipt/acknowledgment slip
  • Collect your transcript from the same office or request delivery by courier (additional fee)
⚠️ Note: Offline applications typically take longer (20-40 working days) than online applications. Online is strongly recommended for faster processing.
📋 Required Documents for Transcript Application
  • ✅ Copy of CNIC (Student's own CNIC - attested)
  • ✅ Copy of Roll Number Slip (any semester)
  • ✅ Copy of Matric Certificate (for name verification)
  • ✅ Passport-size photographs (2 copies) - for offline only
  • ✅ Previous DMC/Transcript (if applying for additional copies)
  • ✅ Fee Payment Receipt/Challan (proof of payment)
  • ✅ Application Form (filled and signed)

📌 Payment Methods: Bank challan (Habib Bank, National Bank, or UBL), Online banking, Easypaisa, JazzCash, Credit/Debit card (for online applications).
🌍 International Transcript Application (For Students Abroad)

If you're living outside Pakistan and need your AIOU transcript, follow these steps:

  • Online Application: Use the online transcript portal as described above. Select "International Delivery" option.
  • Fee Payment: Pay via international credit card or bank transfer (USD equivalent).
  • Courier Delivery: Transcripts are sent via DHL, TCS, or Pakistan Post International. Additional courier charges apply (approx. Rs. 3,000 - 5,000).
  • Processing Time: 25-40 working days (including international shipping).
  • Attestation: For use abroad, you may also need HEC and embassy attestation (separate process).
⚠️ Important for International Students: Always apply at least 3 months before your university application deadline to account for processing and shipping delays.

  • Online Tracking: Visit the AIOU Transcript Portal and enter your Application Tracking Number (provided after submission).
  • SMS Tracking: Send TRACK [Application Number] to 8008 to get status update.
  • Email Inquiry: Send an email to transcripts@aiou.edu.pk with your tracking number and roll number.
  • Phone Inquiry: Call AIOU Helpline at 051-111-112-468 (Extension 4 for Examinations) and provide your tracking number.
❌ Common Problems & Solutions
🔴 Problem: Transcript Not Received After 30 Days

Solution: Check tracking status online. Call the Examination Department at 051-111-112-468 (Ext 4). If lost in courier, you may need to apply for a duplicate (with additional fee).

🔴 Problem: Name Mismatch on Transcript

Solution: Name mismatches between CNIC and academic records are common. Submit a correction application with:

  • Copy of CNIC
  • Copy of Matric certificate
  • Affidavit on stamp paper (Rs. 50-100)
  • Correction fee (approx. Rs. 500-1,000)

🔴 Problem: Online Portal Not Working

Solution: Try during off-peak hours (early morning). Clear browser cache. Use Google Chrome or Firefox. If still not working, apply offline at regional office.

🔴 Problem: Lost Original Transcript

Solution: Apply for a Duplicate Transcript. You'll need:

  • Police report (if lost/stolen)
  • Affidavit on stamp paper
  • Copy of CNIC
  • Duplicate fee (Rs. 3,000 - 4,000)

❓ Frequently Asked Questions
📌 Q1: How many copies of transcript should I order?

Order at least 3-5 copies when you apply. Additional copies cost less than ordering separately later. Keep 1 copy for yourself, and use others for different applications.

📌 Q2: Is transcript different from degree certificate?

Yes! Transcript/DMC shows all subjects with semester-wise marks and CGPA. Degree Certificate only confirms program completion. Most employers and universities need BOTH.

📌 Q3: Can I get my transcript attested by HEC?

Yes, but you need to apply to HEC separately. AIOU transcript must be original (not photocopy) for HEC attestation. HEC attestation fee is additional (approx. Rs. 2,000 - 5,000).

📌 Q4: How long is the transcript valid for?

Official transcripts have no expiration date. They are valid forever. However, some employers may request recent transcripts (issued within last 6 months) for verification purposes.

📌 Q5: Can I apply for a transcript before completing my degree?

Yes, you can apply for a provisional transcript for completed semesters. Final transcript is only issued after full program completion.

📌 Q6: What is the difference between normal and urgent processing?

Urgent processing prioritizes your application and reduces processing time from 30 days to 5-10 days. Fee is higher (approx. Rs. 3,000 - 5,000).

📌 Q7: Can someone else collect my transcript on my behalf?

Yes, but they need an authorization letter signed by you, plus a copy of your CNIC and their original CNIC for identification.

📌 Q8: I passed in 1995. Can I still get a transcript?

Yes! AIOU maintains records for all past students. However, processing may take longer (45-60 days) as old records need to be retrieved from archives.

📊 How to Check AIOU Result Online & Via SMS 2026

📅 Updated: April 12, 2026 ⏱️ Reading Time: 7 min read 📚 Category: AIOU Resources ⭐ Rating: ★★★★★

Waiting for your AIOU exam results can be stressful. Whether you've appeared for BA, BSc, MA, MSc, B.Ed, or any other program, knowing how and where to check your result saves time and reduces anxiety.

In this complete guide, we'll walk you through every method to check your AIOU result — online via the official portal, SMS to 8008, and through regional offices. We'll also explain how to understand your result marksheet and what to do if you face any issues.

📌 Did You Know? AIOU usually announces results 60-90 days after the final exams. Spring semester results (exams in June) are typically announced in August-September, while Autumn semester results (exams in December) are announced in February-March.
🔍 4 Methods to Check AIOU Result
💻 Method 1: Check AIOU Result Online (Official Website)

The most reliable and detailed method is through AIOU's official result portal. You can view your full marksheet with subject-wise grades.

📝 Step-by-Step Process:
  • Visit the official AIOU result portal: https://www.aiou.edu.pk/Results
  • Select your Program Level (Matric, FA, BA, BSc, MA, MSc, B.Ed, M.Ed, etc.)
  • Select your Semester (Spring or Autumn) and Year
  • Enter your Roll Number (found on your roll number slip)
  • Enter the Captcha Code shown on screen
  • Click the "Submit" or "Get Result" button
  • Your result will appear on screen showing: Student Name, Father's Name, Course Codes, Theory Marks, Practical Marks, Total Marks, Grade, and Status (Pass/Fail)
  • You can download and print the result for future reference
🔗 Direct Result Portal Link: https://www.aiou.edu.pk/Results
✅ Pro Tip: Bookmark the result portal on your browser for quick access. Results are usually uploaded by 10:00 AM on announcement day.
📱 Method 2: Check AIOU Result via SMS (8008)

No internet? No problem! AIOU offers a fast SMS service to check results. This works on all mobile networks (Jazz, Zong, Telenor, Ufone).

Type: RESULT (space) Roll Number
Send to: 8008

Example: If your roll number is 123456789, type RESULT 123456789 and send to 8008.

You will receive an SMS reply with:

  • Student Name
  • Roll Number
  • Program Name
  • Total Obtained Marks / Total Marks
  • Percentage
  • Grade
  • Status (Pass/Fail)
⚠️ Important: Standard SMS charges apply (approx. Rs. 2-5 per SMS). Ensure you have sufficient balance before sending.
📚 Method 3: Check Result via AIOU Aaghi Portal (LMS)

The Aaghi Learning Management System (LMS) also displays your results once announced. This method also shows your assignment marks separately.

  • Visit the Aaghi Portal: https://aaghi.aiou.edu.pk
  • Login with your Roll Number and Password
  • Navigate to "My Results" or "Examination" section
  • Select the relevant semester and course
  • Your result including assignment marks, practical marks, and theory marks will be displayed
📌 Note: The Aaghi Portal shows more detailed results than the public result portal, including assignment breakdowns. Highly recommended for students who want to see their complete performance.
🏢 Method 4: Check Result at AIOU Regional Office

If you prefer physical assistance or have trouble with online methods, you can visit your nearest AIOU regional office.

  • Visit your nearest AIOU Regional Office (list of major offices below)
  • Go to the "Examination" or "Student Services" counter
  • Provide your Roll Number and CNIC
  • The staff will print your result or provide a verification letter
  • Small fee may apply for printed copies (approx. Rs. 50-100)

📍 Major AIOU Regional Offices:

  • Islamabad (Main Campus): Sector H-8, Islamabad
  • Lahore: 22-Empress Road, Lahore
  • Karachi: ST-1, Block 15, Gulshan-e-Iqbal, Karachi
  • Peshawar: 13-B, Khyber Road, University Town, Peshawar
  • Quetta: Sariab Road, Near Passport Office, Quetta
  • Multan: 3-KM Bosan Road, Multan
  • Faisalabad: Samundri Road, Faisalabad

❌ Common Issues & Solutions
🔴 Problem: "Result Not Found" Error

Solution: This usually means your result hasn't been uploaded yet. Wait 2-3 days and try again. If still not found, verify your roll number is correct (check your roll number slip). Contact your regional office if the problem persists.

🔴 Problem: SMS Not Working (8008)

Solution: Ensure correct format: RESULT [Roll Number] (space between RESULT and roll number). Check your balance. Try sending from a different mobile network. Use online method as alternative.

🔴 Problem: Forgot Roll Number

Solution: Check your roll number slip, admission form, or old result cards. You can also send ROLL [CNIC Number] to 8008 to retrieve your roll number. Alternatively, contact your regional office.

🔴 Problem: Result Shows "Fail" But I Think I Passed

Solution: Request a rechecking/re-evaluation of your papers. Submit an application to the Examination Department within 15 days of result announcement. Fee: approx. Rs. 500-1,000 per paper.

🔴 Problem: Result Portal Not Loading

Solution: High traffic on result day is common. Try during off-peak hours (early morning or late night). Use SMS method for quick results. Clear your browser cache or try a different browser.

📋 What to Do After Checking Your Result
  • ✅ Save/Download your result – Take a screenshot or print a copy for your records.
  • ✅ Apply for transcripts – If you've passed all courses, apply for your official transcript/DMC.
  • ✅ Apply for degree – For final semester students, apply for your degree certificate.
  • ✅ Request rechecking – If you're unhappy with your marks, apply within 15 days.
  • ✅ Contact tutor – Discuss your performance with your tutor for improvement tips.
  • ✅ Prepare for next semester – If promoted, start preparing for upcoming courses.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions
📌 Q1: How long after exams does AIOU announce results?

Typically 60-90 days after the last exam. For semester systems, results come in 2-3 months. For annual systems, results take 3-4 months.

📌 Q2: Can I check my AIOU result without roll number?

No, the roll number is mandatory. If you've lost it, send ROLL [CNIC Number] to 8008 to retrieve your roll number first.

📌 Q3: Is the SMS result service free?

No, standard SMS charges apply (Rs. 2-5 per SMS depending on your network). Online checking is completely free.

📌 Q4: What do I do if I fail one subject?

You will need to appear for a supplementary exam for that subject. Apply for the supplementary exam when announced. You don't need to repeat the entire year/semester.

📌 Q5: Can I get my original marksheet online?

The online result is an unofficial copy. For official marksheets, you must apply to the Examination Department and pay the prescribed fee (Rs. 500-1,500 per copy).

📌 Q6: How are assignment marks included in the final result?

Assignment marks typically count for 30-40% of your final grade. Theory exam marks count for 60-70%. Both are combined to calculate your final result.

📌 Q7: What is the passing percentage in AIOU?

Minimum 40% marks are required to pass each subject. For some professional programs (like B.Ed, M.Ed), the passing percentage may be 50%.

🎓 AIOU Degree Verification Process 2026 – Complete Guide

📅 Updated: April 12, 2026 ⏱️ Reading Time: 9 min read 📚 Category: AIOU Resources ⭐ Rating: ★★★★★

After years of hard work and dedication, receiving your degree from Allama Iqbal Open University (AIOU) is a proud moment. However, when applying for jobs, higher education abroad, or government positions, you'll often need to verify the authenticity of your AIOU degree. Employers and institutions want to confirm that your degree is genuine and recognized.

In this comprehensive guide, we'll explain every method to verify your AIOU degree — whether you're a student, an employer, or a foreign university. We'll cover online verification via HEC and AIOU portals, SMS verification, and the official verification process for international use.

📌 Why is Degree Verification Important? Degree verification protects against fake degrees, ensures credibility for employers, and is mandatory for higher education admissions, visa applications, and government job appointments.
✅ AIOU Degree Recognition Status

Before we dive into verification methods, it's important to know that AIOU degrees are fully recognized by:

  • 🏛️ Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan – All AIOU programs are HEC-approved
  • 🌍 International Universities – AIOU is recognized by UNESCO and many foreign institutions
  • 🏢 Government of Pakistan – AIOU degrees are valid for all government jobs (FPSC, PPSC, SPSC, etc.)
  • 📜 Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) – For engineering programs
  • ⚖️ Pakistan Bar Council – For law programs (LLB)
🔍 4 Methods to Verify AIOU Degree
🌐 Method 1: HEC Degree Verification System (Recommended)

The Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan maintains the official Degree Verification System (DVS) for all recognized universities including AIOU. This is the most trusted method for employers and institutions.

📝 Step-by-Step Process:
  • Visit HEC Degree Verification System: https://hec.gov.pk → Click on "Verification" → "Degree Verification System (DVS)"
  • Select "Allama Iqbal Open University (AIOU)" from the dropdown menu
  • Enter the student's Roll Number and Year of Passing
  • Complete the captcha verification
  • Click "Search" to view degree details
  • The system will display: Student Name, Father's Name, Degree Title, CGPA/Marks, Year of Passing, and Verification Status
🔗 Direct HEC DVS Link: https://eportal.hec.gov.pk/degreere verification
✅ What You'll See: A green checkmark confirms the degree is genuine. You can download a verification report (PDF) for official use.
⚠️ Note: HEC's database includes degrees issued after 2010. For older degrees (before 2010), you may need to use AIOU's direct verification method.
🏫 Method 2: AIOU Degree Verification Portal

AIOU has its own online verification system for degrees issued by the university. This is useful for degrees not yet uploaded to HEC's database.

  • Visit AIOU Official Website: https://www.aiou.edu.pk
  • Navigate to "Student Services" → "Degree Verification"
  • Enter the Roll Number and CNIC of the degree holder
  • Select the Program/Semester from the dropdown
  • Click "Verify" to get instant results
📌 Pro Tip: If you don't have the CNIC number, you can use the Roll Number only. However, providing both gives more accurate results.
📱 Method 3: AIOU Degree Verification via SMS

For quick verification without internet access, AIOU offers an SMS-based verification service. This is perfect for employers who need instant confirmation.

Type: DEGREE (space) Roll Number
Send to: 8008

Example: If the roll number is 123456789, type DEGREE 123456789 and send to 8008.

You will receive an SMS reply with:

  • Student Name
  • Degree Title
  • Year of Passing
  • Verification Status (Genuine/Not Found)
⚠️ Important: Standard SMS charges apply. This service works on all major networks (Jazz, Zong, Telenor, Ufone).
🏢 Method 4: Physical Verification via AIOU Regional Office

For official purposes where a physical stamped document is required, you can request verification through AIOU's Controller of Examinations office.

  • Visit the AIOU Main Campus, Islamabad (Sector H-8) or your nearest Regional Office
  • Fill out the "Degree Verification Request Form" (available at the examination section)
  • Submit a copy of the degree and CNIC of the degree holder
  • Pay the verification fee (see fee structure below)
  • Collect the verification certificate (usually takes 3-5 working days)

📍 Main Campus Address:
Allama Iqbal Open University, Sector H-8, Islamabad, Pakistan.
📞 Phone: 051-111-112-468

💰 Degree Verification Fee Structure
Verification TypeFee (PKR)Processing Time
Online Verification (HEC/AIOU Portal)FreeInstant
SMS Verification (8008) Standard SMS charges (approx. Rs. 2-5) Instant
Physical Verification Certificate (Main Campus) Rs. 1,000 - 2,500 (depending on program) 3-5 working days

🌍 International Degree Verification for AIOU Graduates

If you're applying for higher education abroad or seeking employment in another country, you'll need additional verification steps:

📜 Step 1: HEC Attestation

Visit the HEC Attestation Department in Islamabad or your regional HEC office. Required documents:

  • Original AIOU degree
  • Original transcripts/marksheets
  • Copy of CNIC
  • Passport-size photographs (2)
  • HEC attestation fee (approx. Rs. 2,000 - 5,000 per document)
🌐 Step 2: Ministry of Foreign Affairs Attestation

After HEC attestation, the degree must be attested by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) in Islamabad.

🏛️ Step 3: Embassy Attestation

Finally, the degree must be attested by the embassy of the country where you intend to study or work (e.g., UAE Embassy, Saudi Embassy, UK Embassy, etc.).

📌 Important: This entire process can take 2-4 weeks. Consider using professional attestation services if you're not in Islamabad.
❌ Common Issues & Solutions
🔴 Problem: Degree Not Found in HEC Database

Solution: This often happens for degrees issued before 2010 or recently issued degrees (last 6 months). Try AIOU's direct portal or SMS verification. If still not found, contact AIOU Examination Department at 051-111-112-468 (Extension 4).

🔴 Problem: Name Mismatch in Verification

Solution: Name mismatches are common due to spelling errors in CNIC vs. degree. Submit an application to AIOU's Examination Department with proof (CNIC copy, degree copy, and affidavit). Correction takes 2-3 weeks.

🔴 Problem: SMS Verification Not Working

Solution: Ensure you have sufficient balance. Try the correct format: DEGREE [Roll Number] (no spaces after DEGREE? Actually space between DEGREE and roll number). Send to 8008. If still not working, use online portals.

🔴 Problem: Degree Verification for Deceased Person

Solution: Provide the original degree, death certificate, and CNIC of the legal heir. Submit to AIOU Examination Department with a written application. Additional processing time applies.

📋 Documents Required for Physical Verification
  • ✅ Original AIOU Degree Certificate
  • ✅ Original Transcript / Marksheet (DMC)
  • ✅ Copy of CNIC (Student/Owner)
  • ✅ Copy of Roll Number Slip (if available)
  • ✅ Verification Request Form (available at AIOU office)
  • ✅ Fee Payment Receipt (Bank deposit slip)

Phone: 051-111-112-468 (Extension 4 for Examinations)

Email: examinations@aiou.edu.pk

Address: Higher Education Commission, Sector H-9, Islamabad.

Phone: 051-9040-0000

Website: https://hec.gov.pk

❓ Frequently Asked Questions
📌 Q1: How long does AIOU degree verification take online?

Online verification via HEC or AIOU portal is instant. SMS verification takes 10-30 seconds. Physical verification takes 3-5 working days.

📌 Q2: Is AIOU degree verification free?

Online verification (HEC portal, AIOU portal, SMS) is free (excluding SMS charges). Physical verification certificates require a fee (Rs. 1,000 - 5,000).

📌 Q3: Can employers verify my AIOU degree without my consent?

Yes, employers can verify using your roll number (which is usually on your CV/degree). They don't need your CNIC for basic verification.

📌 Q4: What if I lost my AIOU degree certificate?

Apply for a duplicate degree from AIOU's Examination Department. You'll need a police report (if lost/stolen), affidavit, and payment of duplicate fee (approx. Rs. 3,000 - 5,000).

📌 Q5: Are AIOU online degrees verifiable?

Yes, AIOU's online/distance learning degrees are fully recognized and verifiable through all methods mentioned above.

📌 Q6: Can I verify an AIOU degree from outside Pakistan?

Yes! Use the HEC Degree Verification System or AIOU online portal from anywhere in the world. For attested copies, you may need to use courier services or authorized representatives.

📌 Q7: What is the difference between HEC verification and AIOU verification?

HEC verification is the national standard accepted by all government bodies. AIOU verification is university-specific and may be accepted for some purposes, but HEC verification is preferred for jobs and higher education.

👨‍🏫 AIOU Tutor Contact Information Guide 2026

📅 Updated: April 12, 2026 ⏱️ Reading Time: 8 min read 📚 Category: AIOU Resources ⭐ Rating: ★★★★★

One of the most common challenges faced by AIOU students is finding their tutor's contact information. Without proper communication with your assigned tutor, you may miss important updates, assignment feedback, or guidance that could improve your grades.

In this comprehensive guide, we'll show you every possible method to find your AIOU tutor's name, code, phone number, and address. We'll also share tips on how to communicate effectively with your tutor for better academic support.

📌 Why is Tutor Contact Important? Your AIOU tutor is responsible for marking your assignments, providing feedback, conducting workshops, and guiding you throughout the semester. Staying in touch can significantly improve your performance.
📋 Who is Your AIOU Tutor?

When you enroll in any AIOU program (Matric, FA, BA, BSc, MA, MSc, B.Ed, M.Ed, etc.), the university assigns a tutor for each course. This tutor is usually an experienced teacher or subject specialist in your region. Your tutor:

  • ✅ Marks your assignments and provides written feedback
  • ✅ Conducts tutorial workshops (if applicable)
  • ✅ Answers your academic queries
  • ✅ Helps you prepare for final exams
🔍 5 Ways to Find Your AIOU Tutor Contact Information
📱 Method 1: Check via SMS (Easiest & Fastest)

AIOU provides a dedicated SMS service to get tutor details instantly. This works on all mobile networks (Jazz, Zong, Telenor, Ufone).

Type: TUTOR (space) Your Roll Number
Send to: 8008

Example: If your roll number is 123456789, type TUTOR 123456789 and send to 8008.

You will receive an SMS with your tutor's name, tutor code, phone number, and sometimes address.

✅ SMS Reply Example:
"Your Tutor for Course Code 1429 is Mr. Ahmed Ali (Tutor Code: T-12345). Contact: 03XXXXXXXXX. Address: XYZ Colony, Lahore."
💻 Method 2: AIOU Aaghi Portal (LMS)

The AIOU Aaghi Portal (Learning Management System) is the official online platform where you can access tutor details, assignments, and study materials.

  • Visit: https://aaghi.aiou.edu.pk
  • Login with your Roll Number and Password (default password usually your roll number or CNIC)
  • Navigate to "My Courses" or "Tutor Information" section
  • Click on your course to view tutor name, contact, and schedule
⚠️ Note: If you can't log in, try resetting your password via the "Forgot Password" option or contact AIOU's IT support at 051-111-112-468.
🏢 Method 3: Visit Your Regional Office

AIOU has regional offices in every major city of Pakistan. Visit the office with your roll number and CNIC, and the staff will provide your tutor's contact details.

Major AIOU Regional Offices:

  • Islamabad/Rawalpindi: Sector H-8, Islamabad
  • Lahore: 22-Empress Road, Lahore
  • Karachi: ST-1, Block 15, Gulshan-e-Iqbal, Karachi
  • Peshawar: 13-B, Khyber Road, University Town, Peshawar
  • Quetta: Sariab Road, Near Passport Office, Quetta
  • Multan: 3-KM Bosan Road, Multan
  • Faisalabad: Samundri Road, Faisalabad

Call AIOU Helpline: 051-111-112-468 to find your nearest regional office.

📧 Method 4: Check Your Admission Form or Prospectus

When you received your admission confirmation or study kit, it may include a "Tutor Allocation Letter". This document contains:

  • Tutor's name and code
  • Tutor's phone number
  • Tutor's mailing address (for submitting assignments)
  • Workshop schedule (if applicable)

Check the envelope or package you received from AIOU. If you've misplaced it, you can request a duplicate from your regional office.

📞 Method 5: Call AIOU Helpline or UAN

AIOU has a dedicated helpline to assist students with tutor-related queries.

📞 AIOU Helpline: 051-111-112-468
📱 UAN Number: 051-9057-000

When calling, have your Roll Number and Course Code ready. The operator will provide tutor details or redirect you to the relevant department.

📌 Pro Tip: Call during working hours (Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM) for faster response. Avoid calling during peak times (12 PM - 2 PM).
📊 AIOU SMS Service Quick Reference
ServiceFormatSend To
Tutor InformationTUTOR [Roll Number]8008
Assignment ResultRESULT [Roll Number]8008
Exam Date SheetDATE [Roll Number]8008
Roll Number SlipSLIP [Roll Number]8008
Fee StatusFEE [Roll Number]8008
💬 How to Communicate Effectively with Your AIOU Tutor
  • ✅ Be respectful and professional: Start with "Assalam-o-Alaikum" or "Dear Sir/Madam".
  • ✅ Introduce yourself properly: Mention your full name, roll number, course code, and semester.
  • ✅ Be specific about your query: Instead of "I need help with assignment", say "I need clarification on question number 3 of Assignment 1 for course code 1429".
  • ✅ Call during appropriate hours: Avoid calling early morning, late night, or on Fridays (prayer time). Best time: 10 AM - 12 PM or 3 PM - 5 PM.
  • ✅ Follow up politely: If you don't get a response in 2-3 days, send a gentle reminder.
  • ✅ Keep records: Save SMS, emails, or notes of your conversations with the tutor.
❌ Common Problems & Solutions
🔴 Problem: SMS to 8008 Not Working

Solution: Ensure you have sufficient balance (SMS charges apply). Try sending from a different mobile network. Alternatively, use the Aaghi Portal or call the helpline.

🔴 Problem: Tutor's Phone is Always Off or Unreachable

Solution: Send a WhatsApp message if the number is available. If still no response, contact your regional office and request an alternative contact method or a tutor change (in extreme cases).

🔴 Problem: Can't Log In to Aaghi Portal

Solution: Default password is usually your roll number or CNIC without dashes. If still not working, click "Forgot Password" or call AIOU IT support at 051-111-112-468 (extension 5).

🔴 Problem: No Tutor Assigned Yet

Solution: Tutor allocation can take 4-6 weeks after admission. If more than 2 months have passed, contact your regional office immediately.

📝 Sample Script for Calling Your AIOU Tutor
Student: "Assalam-o-Alaikum, Sir/Madam. My name is [Your Name]. My roll number is [Roll Number] for course code [Course Code]. I am calling regarding Assignment [Number]. Could you please clarify question [Number]? I would really appreciate your guidance. Thank you."

Tutor's expected response: Usually positive and helpful. Always thank them at the end.
📧 Sample Email to AIOU Tutor
Subject: Query Regarding Assignment - [Course Code] - [Your Roll Number]

Respected Sir/Madam,

Assalam-o-Alaikum. My name is [Your Name], roll number [Roll Number], enrolled in [Program Name] for semester [Semester].

I am writing to seek clarification on question number [X] of Assignment [Number] for course [Course Code]. Specifically, I would like to understand [explain your query briefly].

I have attached my attempt for your reference. Kindly guide me if I am on the right track.

Thank you for your time and support.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
[Roll Number]
[Phone Number]

📌 Q1: How long does it take for tutor allocation after admission?

Yes, but only for valid reasons (e.g., tutor is unresponsive, relocated, or conflict of interest). Submit a written application to your regional office.

Contact your regional office and explain the situation. They may provide an alternative contact or reassign you.

Yes, through the Aaghi Portal. You can send messages to your tutor within the LMS system.

It's better to avoid weekends. Most tutors prefer contact during weekdays (Monday to Friday), 9 AM to 6 PM.

Your roll number, course code, assignment number, and specific question number. This helps the tutor assist you quickly.

📚 Top 10 Reference Books for AIOU Assignments (2026 Edition)

📅 Updated: April 12, 2026 ⏱️ Reading Time: 9 min read 📚 Category: AIOU Resources ⭐ Rating: ★★★★★

Writing high-quality assignments for Allama Iqbal Open University (AIOU) requires more than just your textbooks. Using reference books adds depth, credibility, and academic rigor to your work — directly translating into higher marks. But with thousands of books available, which ones actually make a difference?

In this guide, we've curated the top 10 reference books for AIOU assignments across various programs including BA, BSc, MA, MSc, B.Ed, and M.Ed. These books are widely available, trusted by AIOU tutors, and proven to help students score better.

📌 Why Use Reference Books? AIOU examiners specifically look for evidence of wider reading. Citing quality references can boost your assignment score by 10-15% compared to using only the course textbook.
🏆 Top 10 Reference Books for AIOU Students
1
Research Methodology: Methods and Techniques
By Dr. C.R. Kothari & Dr. Gaurav Garg
The ultimate guide for research-based assignments. Covers research design, sampling methods, data collection, and report writing. Essential for MA, MSc, and M.Ed students working on research projects and thesis assignments.
📖 MA / MSc / M.Ed / PhD
2
Educational Psychology
By Dr. S.K. Mangal
A must-have for B.Ed, M.Ed, and Education programs. Covers learning theories, child development, motivation, and classroom management. Frequently referenced in AIOU education assignments.
📖 B.Ed / M.Ed / BA Education
3
Principles of Economics
By N. Gregory Mankiw
The global standard for economics students. Covers micro and macroeconomics with clear examples. Perfect for BA Economics, B.Com, and MBA assignments requiring economic analysis.
📖 BA Economics / B.Com / MBA
4
Introduction to Political Science
By Dr. Mazhar-ul-Haq
Comprehensive coverage of political theory, systems of government, constitution, and international relations. Widely used by BA Political Science students for assignments on governance and political ideologies.
📖 BA Political Science / MA Political Science
5
A History of Pakistan & India
By Dr. M.R. Kazmi
Essential for history and Pakistan Studies assignments. Covers the partition, independence movement, political development, and cultural heritage. Trusted reference for BA History and Pakistan Studies papers.
📖 BA History / Pakistan Studies / CSS
6
Business Communication
By Dr. K.K. Sinha
Master the art of professional writing, report drafting, and presentation skills. Indispensable for B.Com, MBA, and BBA students working on business-related assignments and case studies.
📖 B.Com / MBA / BBA
7
Sociology: Principles of Sociology with an Introduction to Social Thought
By C.N. Shankar Rao
Covers sociological concepts, social institutions, culture, stratification, and social change. Highly recommended for BA Sociology and MA Sociology assignments requiring theoretical frameworks.
📖 BA Sociology / MA Sociology
8
English Grammar & Composition
By Wren & Martin
The timeless classic for English assignments. Perfect for improving writing skills, understanding grammar rules, and mastering essay composition. Essential for all BA English and general assignments.
📖 BA English / All Programs (General Writing)
9
Islamic Studies
By Dr. Tahir-ul-Qadri (or standard HEC curriculum book)
Comprehensive coverage of Islamic teachings, Quranic studies, Hadith, and Islamic history. Required reference for Islamic Studies / Islamiat assignments in all AIOU programs.
📖 All Programs (Compulsory Islamiat)
10
Quantitative Techniques for Business Decisions
By Dr. J.K. Sharma
Perfect for statistics, mathematics, and quantitative analysis assignments. Covers statistical methods, probability, regression, and data interpretation. Essential for B.Sc, B.Com, and MBA students.
📖 B.Sc Statistics / B.Com / MBA / Economics
📖 How to Use Reference Books Effectively in AIOU Assignments
  • ✅ Cite properly: Always mention the book title, author, and page number when quoting or paraphrasing.
  • ✅ Don't over-copy: Use references to support YOUR analysis, not replace it. Paraphrase in your own words.
  • ✅ Mix sources: Use 3-5 different references per assignment to show comprehensive research.
  • ✅ Prioritize recent editions: Newer editions have updated information (prefer within last 10-15 years).
  • ✅ Add a bibliography: Include a "References" or "Bibliography" section at the end of your assignment.
📍 Where to Find These Reference Books?

Here are the best places to get these reference books for your AIOU assignments:

  • 📚 Urdu Bazaar, Lahore – Pakistan's largest book market with discounted prices
  • 📚 Saddar Book Markets (Karachi, Rawalpindi, Peshawar, Quetta) – Local bookstores in major cities
  • 📚 Online Stores: Daraz.pk, Readings, Liberty Books
  • 📚 AIOU Regional Libraries – Free borrowing for enrolled students
  • 📚 PDF Versions: Google Scholar, Academia.edu, and archive.org (for older editions)
⚠️ Important Note: Always verify with your course tutor or program coordinator if specific reference books are recommended for your particular course code. Different programs may have preferred authors or editions.

No! Focus on 2-3 books most relevant to your program. Many books are available in AIOU libraries or as PDFs online. Start with the ones your tutor specifically recommends.

For subjects like History, Literature, or Philosophy, older books are fine. For Science, Technology, Business, or Research Methods, prefer newer editions (last 5-10 years).

✍️ Assignment Writing for AIOU: Complete Guide 2026

📅 Updated: April 12, 2026 ⏱️ Reading Time: 8 min read 📚 Category: Assignment Writing

Allama Iqbal Open University (AIOU) is one of the largest distance learning universities in the world, serving thousands of students across Pakistan and beyond. Assignments play a critical role in your final grade — contributing 30-40% of your total marks in most programs. Writing high-quality assignments is not just about passing; it's about maximizing your score and building a strong academic foundation.

In this comprehensive guide, we'll walk you through everything you need to know about AIOU assignment writing — from understanding the format to avoiding common mistakes that cost students valuable marks.

📌 Did You Know? AIOU assignments carry significant weight in your final result. A well-written assignment can boost your overall grade even if your exam performance isn't perfect.
📚 Understanding AIOU Assignment Structure

AIOU provides specific assignment questions for each course in your "study material" or via the AIOU Aaghi Portal (https://aaghi.aiou.edu.pk). Typically, each course has 2-4 assignments per semester. Here's the standard structure AIOU expects:

SectionDescriptionWeightage
Title PageCourse code, course name, student name, registration number, tutor name, semester, date5%
Table of ContentsClear listing of questions and page numbers5%
Answers to QuestionsDetailed, research-based answers to each assignment question80%
References/BibliographyProper citation of sources used5%
Presentation & NeatnessHandwritten or typed, clean format5%
📝 Step-by-Step Guide to Writing AIOU Assignments
1️⃣ Read the Assignment Questions Carefully

Before you start writing, read each question at least twice. Underline keywords like "explain," "compare," "analyze," "discuss," or "evaluate." These words tell you exactly what the examiner expects. For example:

  • "Explain" → Provide details and examples
  • "Compare" → Show similarities and differences
  • "Analyze" → Break down into parts and examine each
  • "Evaluate" → Give your judgment with evidence
2️⃣ Gather Reference Material

Use your AIOU textbooks as the primary source. Supplement with:

  • Recommended books mentioned in your course outline
  • Google Scholar for academic articles
  • Library resources (physical or digital)
  • Reliable educational websites
3️⃣ Create an Outline Before Writing

For each question, create a quick outline:

  • Introduction: Define key terms, state what you'll cover
  • Main Body: 3-5 key points with explanations and examples
  • Conclusion: Summarize main points, give final insight
4️⃣ Write Clear, Concise Answers

AIOU examiners appreciate clarity over complexity. Follow these rules:

  • Write in complete sentences and logical paragraphs
  • Use headings and subheadings for long answers
  • Include examples to support your points
  • Define technical terms when first used
  • Keep handwriting neat (if handwritten) or use clean formatting (if typed)
5️⃣ Add References Properly

AIOU prefers standard citation styles. Use APA format for social sciences and MLA for humanities. Example (APA):

Book: Author, A. A. (Year). Title of book. Publisher.
Website: Author, A. A. (Year, Month Date). Title of page. Website Name. URL
6️⃣ Review and Edit Before Submission

Never submit your first draft. Check for:

  • ✓ Spelling and grammar errors
  • ✓ Completeness (did you answer all parts of each question?)
  • ✓ Proper formatting and page numbering
  • ✓ Correct references and citations
  • ✓ Your name, registration number, and course code on every page
❌ Common Mistakes to Avoid in AIOU Assignments
  • Copying directly from textbooks – AIOU checks for plagiarism; paraphrase in your own words.
  • Ignoring the word limit – Stay within 10% of the suggested length.
  • Submitting late – Late submissions lose marks or may not be accepted.
  • Poor handwriting – If handwritten, use blue or black ink and maintain legibility.
  • Missing page numbers – Always number your pages for easy reference.
  • No table of contents – This makes it hard for tutors to navigate your work.
📅 AIOU Assignment Submission Schedule 2026

AIOU typically follows two semesters per year. Here's the general schedule (verify with your specific program):

SemesterAssignment Submission Deadlines
Spring SemesterAssignment 1: May 15 | Assignment 2: June 30
Autumn SemesterAssignment 1: November 15 | Assignment 2: December 31

Always check the AIOU Aaghi Portal or your regional office for exact dates for your program code.

💡 Pro Tips for High Scores in AIOU Assignments
  • 🎯 Start early – Don't wait until the last week. Good assignments take time.
  • 🎯 Use diagrams and tables – Visual elements make your answers stand out.
  • 🎯 Answer every question – Even if unsure, write something relevant.
  • 🎯 Follow tutor feedback – Previous assignment feedback helps improve future ones.
  • 🎯 Keep a copy – Always photocopy or scan your assignment before submission.
📱 How to Submit AIOU Assignments

AIOU offers multiple submission methods:

  • Physical Submission: Submit handwritten or typed assignments at your nearest AIOU regional office or tutor's address.
  • Online Submission (Aaghi Portal): Upload PDF files through the Aaghi LMS portal.
  • WhatsApp/Courier: Some tutors accept assignments via WhatsApp or courier (verify with your tutor first).

Important: Always get a receipt or acknowledgment when submitting physically.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (AIOU Assignments)
📌 Q1: Can I type my AIOU assignment instead of handwriting?

Yes, most AIOU programs accept typed assignments. Use Times New Roman or Arial font, size 12, with 1.5 line spacing. Save as PDF before submitting online.

📌 Q2: What happens if I miss an assignment deadline?

Late submissions may be accepted with a penalty, or not accepted at all. Contact your tutor immediately if you anticipate missing a deadline. Some programs allow you to submit with the next semester.

📌 Q3: How are AIOU assignments graded?

Tutors evaluate based on: accuracy of content (40%), depth of analysis (30%), presentation (15%), and references (15%). Each assignment is marked out of 100.

📌 Q4: Can I use the internet for research?

Absolutely! Just ensure you use credible sources (educational websites, Google Scholar, research journals). Avoid Wikipedia as a primary source.

📌 Q5: How do I check my assignment result?

Log in to the AIOU Aaghi Portal or check your tutor's marked copy. Results are also available via SMS service (type your registration number and send to the official AIOU code).
